flavor: A thick, cloying incense of dried hemlock and old bone dust hangs in the airless chamber. In the center, a jagged altar of obsidian is stained with something darker than any candle wax, surrounded by hundreds of small, hand-carved effigies that seem to watch the doorway.
name: The Ossuary of Unspoken Vows
reason: The party must perform a ritual of desecration or atonement to unlock the heavy iron gate on the far side.
